# zip test fixtures

Generated by `tools/gen_zip_oracle.py` (the python3 zipfile
oracle; provenance in manifest.edn):

```
python3 tools/gen_zip_oracle.py
```

- `basic.zip` -- deflate + stored members, a directory
  entry, explicit and DOS-minimum mtimes, a CD comment.
- `utf8.zip` -- bit-11 non-ASCII names beside ASCII.
- `cp437.bin` -- high-half CP437 name without bit 11
  (hand-crafted; pinned to python's cp437 decode).
- `mojibake.bin` -- raw UTF-8 name without bit 11 (the
  writer-bug shape; mojibakes exactly as python's).
- `zip64.bin` -- hand-crafted 64-bit central directory
  (zip64 EOCD + locator + CDH zip64 size extra).
- `descriptor.zip` -- bit-3 data descriptors (streaming
  write).
- `methods.zip` -- bzip2 (12) and lzma (14) members.
- `dup.zip` -- duplicate name, different bytes (D8 first
  match).
- `overlap.bin` -- two CD entries sharing one local
  header.
- `encrypted.bin` -- general-purpose bit 0 with no
  payload encryption.
- `bomb.bin` -- 4-byte body declaring ~4 GiB (the
  declared-size cap fixture).
- `manifest.edn` -- archive SHA-256s, expected entry
  vectors in archive order, content SHA-256s.

Compressed bodies are never compared between mino and
python (the R4 golden split): the archives pin the read
side, decode interop only.
